name: MonarchAiHandoff
title: AiHandoff
wrapsNative: HStack of MonarchAiAgentAvatar, MonarchIcon and MonarchAvatar, Text, a dashed stroked Shape, RelativeDateTimeFormatter
summary: A marker in a thread where one agent hands the work to another agent or to a person, with the reason and the time.
whenToUse: When a coordinating agent routes the conversation to a specialist agent, or an agent escalates to a person for an approval or a judgement call.
whenNotToUse: Not for a day change, a context reset or a summary: use MonarchAiContextDivider. Not when the agent simply asks the person a question: that is a normal message.
api: init(from: MonarchAiAgentRef, to: MonarchAiHandoffTarget, reason: String? = nil, date: Date? = nil, now: Date? = nil, labels: MonarchAiHandoffLabels = MonarchAiHandoffLabels())
enum MonarchAiHandoffTarget { case agent(MonarchAiAgentRef), person(name: String, avatarURL: URL? = nil); var name: String; var isPerson: Bool }
struct MonarchAiHandoffLabels { var label: String?; var handedOff: (@Sendable (String, String, Bool) -> String)?; var agentKind: String?; var reason: String? }

options.name: from
options.description: The agent that hands the work over.

options.name: to
options.description: The agent, or the person, that takes the work.

options.name: reason
options.description: Why the work moved, shown under the sentence in muted text.

options.name: date
options.description: When it happened, shown as a relative time such as "3 minutes ago".

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for date. nil is the current time.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Handoff", the sentence, "AI agent" and "Reason:".

states.name: to an agent
states.description: The target is a square agent avatar; the dashed lines, border and arrow use the AI colours.

states.name: to a person
states.description: The target is a round avatar; the lines and border are the neutral border colour.

states.name: accessibility text size
states.description: The side lines are dropped so the sentence keeps the width.

appearance: A body with a dashed rounded border between two dashed side lines. Lines and border use the AI border role for an agent target and the default border role for a person; the sentence is default text, the reason muted text and the time subtle text. All roles come from the theme, so the four themes differ only in their values.
platformNotes: The web takes reason as any node and a locale prop; here the reason is a String and the locale, calendar and time zone come from the SwiftUI environment. The web drops the side lines below 30rem; iOS drops them at accessibility text sizes. The web marks the root with the note role; SwiftUI has no note trait, so the marker is one static element whose label starts with "Handoff". The arrow is the SF Symbol arrow.forward, which flips right to left.
accessibility: The marker is one element read as "Handoff", the sentence, "Reason:" and the reason, then the time.
Agent names are read with "(AI agent)" after them; a person's name is not, so the direction is clear without the pictures.
The avatars, the arrow and the lines are hidden from VoiceOver.
The sentence is built by a function of both names, so a translation can reorder it.
Text scales with Dynamic Type and wraps; nothing is interactive.
edgeCases: An empty reason is treated as no reason.
Long names and reasons wrap inside the border; the side lines keep a least length of 16 points.
Without date no time is shown; now only matters with date.

examples.title: Agent to agent
examples.code:
MonarchAiHandoff(
    from: MonarchAiAgentRef(id: "research", name: "Research agent"),
    to: .agent(MonarchAiAgentRef(id: "writer", name: "Writing agent")),
    reason: "Sources are ready to draft from",
    date: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_772_452_620),
    now: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_772_452_800)
)
